title: Convert PowerShell worktree helpers to cross-platform Node scripts
description: Dev env migrated from native Windows+PowerShell to WSL Ubuntu+bash. scripts/agent-preflight-main.ps1 and scripts/verify-current-worktree.ps1 plus their package.json wrappers invoke 'powershell', which does not exist on WSL, breaking 'npm run agent:preflight' and 'npm run verify:worktree'. Rewrite both as Node .mjs (cross-platform), update package.json, nodeRuntimePolicy.test.ts assertions, and AGENTS.md worktree docs. Leave intentional Windows-runtime support (ci.yml pwsh install-smoke, process.platform guards) untouched.
close_reason: Converted PowerShell worktree helpers to cross-platform Node .mjs; PR #209 opened
